purpose: Two prospective checks of the separating-task and misspecified-subspace predictions. No model selection or real-data tuning.

separation.model: Two single-code signed relations w1=s*w2, s in {-1,+1}. The generating sign is sampled separately for each family. In uninformative sources x2=0. In informative sources both coordinates are independent standard Gaussian. The task coefficient is uniform on [0.7,1.3].
separation.prediction: The incorrect relation survives with probability (1-p)^T at population level. With p=0 both relations must survive. With p>0 compare the ordinary fitted compatibility procedure with the oracle event of receiving zero informative tasks.

misspecification.model: Isotropic Gaussian linear regression, compare ordinary least squares with and without the signed relation w1=w2 on identical training examples.
misspecification.prediction: The gain in noiseless query MSE (Dense minus constrained) changes sign at b=1/15. Expected gains are 0.0066667, 0.0042667, -0.0149333 in the stated order. Evaluate conditional query risk exactly by the squared parameter error.
